name: van-code
description: Jean-Claude Van Code: a flying-kick intro plus guards, checks and cheap reviews for assertive, economical coding with Claude Code

intro.title: Intro animation
intro.description: The flying kick into Clawd when Claude starts. Off: the factory checklist shows only when something is missing.

guard.title: Heavy-file guard
guard.description: Blocks whole reads of lockfiles, node_modules, build output and minified files. /van-code-guard toggles it for the session.

readMemory.title: Read memory
readMemory.description: Refuses to re-read a file that has not changed since the last read.

postEditCheck.title: Post-edit check
postEditCheck.description: Runs tsc, ruff, go vet or bash -n on the edited file and hands the errors back to Claude.

proveIt.title: Prove it works
proveIt.description: Asks Claude to verify when it edits code and runs no test or build.

chongLi.title: Automatic Chong Li
chongLi.description: A cheap adversarial review (Haiku) of big or risky changes. /chong-li always works.

suggestions.title: Reply suggestions
suggestions.description: Proposes your next message (Tab) when Claude Code proposes none. Uses Haiku.

rules.title: Van Code rules
rules.description: Extra instructions for Claude: verify before claiming, read only what is needed, be direct, test before saying done.

infraGuard.title: Infra guard
infraGuard.description: Holds terraform/tofu apply, kubectl and helm changes until a plan, diff or dry run ran, and refuses deletes (kubectl, helm, aws, gcloud, az, pulumi) once. Running the command again goes through.

compactRestore.title: Compaction restore
compactRestore.description: Tells the summarizer to keep constraints and decisions, then hands Claude your own messages (verbatim) and the assumption ledger right after a compaction.

compactTrim.title: Compaction trim
compactTrim.description: Before a compaction, cuts old tool output over 2,000 characters to its first 600, so the summary is cheaper and about decisions, not dumps. The newest 12 messages and errors stay whole.

cardPlan.title: Card plan
cardPlan.description: When a message reads as a pasted user story, bug report or task card, Claude is told to list its acceptance criteria as targets, ask only what is ambiguous, and reproduce a bug before fixing it.

usageHeader.title: Usage header
usageHeader.description: Model, rate-limit bars (5h, 7d) with time until reset, and context, above the prompt.
